1.

The present appeal has been preferred by the State seeking enhancement of the sentence awarded to the respondent nos. 1 and 2 post their conviction under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1954.
2.
There is no appearance on behalf of the respondents when the matter is called out.
3. Issue bailable warrants to respondent nos. 1 and 2 in the sum of Rs. 5,000/-, returnable on 31.07.2024.
VIKAS MAHAJAN, J MARCH 21, 2024 N.S. ASWAL
